findings.message:
Behavior Change. `CircleIcon` now renders a horizontal `line` whenever no fill color resolves. Before, it rendered an unfilled, stroked circle.

This affects every circle legend step that defines only a stroke, for example `circle-stroke-color` or `color` with no `fill-color` or `circle-color`. Those hollow-ring markers will silently become line markers, both in `SimpleLegend` and anywhere else `CircleIcon` is used.

If the line rendering is meant only for line-type layers, consider a separate shape or an explicit prop instead of keying off a missing fill.
